results.headline: Death toll tops 470 as barrier lake overflow halts Nepal-Bhutan rescue
results.reason: headline: says 'Nepal-Bhutan rescue' but every cited source (and the story's own summary) describes a Nepal-Tibet/China border disaster; Bhutan is never mentioned in any cited article.

results.headline: Norway's King Harald V dies at 89; son Haakon takes throne
results.reason: Matches cited source articles: death at Oslo University Hospital age 89, automatic succession by Haakon, 35-year reign, Mette-Marit/Epstein correspondence and Marius Borg Høiby's rape conviction are all supported.

results.headline: Ratko Mladić, convicted of genocide at Srebrenica, dies in Hague prison
results.reason: summary: states the Srebrenica massacre killed 'at least 12,000 Muslims,' but cited sources (A115, A225, A358) consistently give the figure as 'at least 8,000 Muslims'.

results.headline: US judge rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was illegal
results.reason: Matches cited sources: Judge Rita Lin's 59-page order, first-ever public supply-chain-risk designation of a US company, blocked over refusal to allow Claude for surveillance/autonomous weapons.

results.headline: Trump says Putin will not attack NATO as Pentagon prepares European defence options
results.reason: Matches cited sources: Trump's comments on Putin/NATO, Colby's four options by November 6 ahead of a December deadline, and the goal of more European-led conventional defence.

results.headline: Iran agrees to draw up Hormuz conditions list; US clears strait of mines
results.reason: why_it_matters: refers to 'the Biden administration' as the current US administration, but the cited sources (e.g., A31, which states Trump declared the prior MOU 'over') make clear the sitting president is Trump, not Biden -- a stale/incorrect world-state assertion.

results.headline: DRC launches Ebola vaccination drive as death toll reaches 2,744
results.reason: why_it_matters: claims 'renewed armed clashes in North Kivu have already forced three vaccination sites to suspend work,' a specific not found in any cited source; A17 instead describes the outbreak as concentrated in Ituri province with no mention of North Kivu or suspended vaccination sites.

results.headline: Syria appoints Kurdish commander Abdi as presidential adviser and allows Kurdish-language schooling
results.reason: Matches cited sources: Abdi's appointment, SDF dissolution, Kurdish-language schooling decree, Turkey's wanted/Interpol status, and Barrack's integration remarks are all supported.

results.headline: Russia strikes Kyiv for second straight day; Kherson told to evacuate
results.reason: Matches cited sources: casualty and damage figures for Kyiv (A221) and the Kherson governor's evacuation appeal and 'no way to destroy' quote plus last winter's power-plant strikes (A220) are all supported.

results.headline: Chinese executives may join Xi's September US visit; trade truce extension seen as near-certain
results.reason: why_it_matters: asserts Washington and Beijing are managing 'a range of active disputes including Iran-related sanctions pressure,' but none of the cited sources (A491, A501, A505) mention Iran or Iran-related sanctions in connection with the US-China relationship.

results.headline: Bangladesh journalists jailed since 2024 remain detained as BNP fails to honour press-freedom pledge
results.reason: summary: states 'Five journalists and a writer' were arrested, but cited source A581 identifies only four journalists (Farzana Rupa, Shakil Ahmed, Mozammel Babu, Shyamal Dutta) plus writer Shahriar Kabir -- five people total, not five journalists plus a writer.

results.headline: Taiwan parliament passes its own drone plan and backs $7bn boost for domestic builders
results.reason: Matches cited sources: parliament rejecting/replacing the drone plan (A456), the $7bn boost (A714), and typhoons/extreme weather disrupting Taiwan Strait readiness (A497).

results.headline: Australia severs ties with two Chinese universities as Pacific rivalry sharpens
results.reason: Matches cited sources: ANU/Shandong and UQ/Chinese Academy of Sciences partnerships ended, alignment with US restrictions, Pacific rivalry and Beijing's ICBM test, and the analyst's warning about exclusion from top-tier research.

results.headline: Trump chip tariff plan could cost $90bn in annual GDP and delay one-fifth of US data centre projects, industry warns
results.reason: summary: claims the tariffs would 'delay or cancel most data centre projects planned through 2030,' but cited source A47 states the CCIA estimate is that 'about 20 percent' (one-fifth) of such projects would be delayed or canceled -- a quantifier contradiction (also inconsistent with the story's own headline, which correctly says 'one-fifth').

results.headline: Fed chair Warsh's Jackson Hole debut scrutinised for rate signals as inflation persists above target
results.reason: summary: names 'Governors Michelle Bowman, Christopher Waller and Lisa Cook' as the dissenters, but cited source A29 states only that 'three of them' dissented in favour of a hike without naming any individuals -- an unsupported attribution upgrade from unnamed officials to named individuals.

results.headline: Zambia opposition leader detained on treason charges ahead of president's inauguration
results.reason: summary: states Mundubile 'finished second ... by fewer than 40,000 votes,' but cited sources A161 and A577 give only that Hichilema won 'around 60%' of the vote, with no specific vote-margin figure stated anywhere.

results.headline: Japan's births rise for first time in 11 years
results.reason: summary: gives specific figures ('731,000 babies born, a 1.8 percent increase') and attributes the rise to 'a post-pandemic rebound in marriages,' but the only cited source, A289, provides no body text beyond its headline ('Japan's number of births rises for first time in 11 years') and does not state any of these figures or the marriage-rebound explanation.
